title: equisetum fluviatile var. uliginosum
intro: Equisetum fluviatile var. uliginosum, commonly known as marsh horsetail, is a variety of the Equisetum fluviatile plant, a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of marsh horsetail include anti-edematous and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be beneficial in treating conditions such as arthritis and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Equisetum fluviatile var. uliginosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and silica, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
